question: The average gini recalculated of the world in 2015
query: SELECT AVG("gini_recalculated") FROM country_income WHERE ("year" = 2015) LIMIT 50;
answer:
Based on the provided query results, I can tell you that the average Gini coefficient for the world in 2015 was approximately **0.39**.

To put this number into perspective: a Gini coefficient of 0 is theoretically perfect equality (where everyone has exactly the same income), while a coefficient of 1 represents maximum inequality (where one person has everything and everyone else has nothing). A value around 0.39 indicates a moderate level of economic inequality in the global economy during that year.

I should note that this result comes solely from the provided dataset, which appears to be a single numerical value representing the average Gini coefficient for all countries worldwide in 2015.
